directions.details: Easily reachable by local e-rickshaw (toto) or cab—a short, scenic ride through Bolpur town.
Just a brief toto ride away, convenient for trains arriving from Howrah and Sealdah.
Smooth highway access via NH-19 / Panagarh–Morgram route toward Bolpur, with direct pin navigation on Google Maps.

rooms.name: The Courtyard Double Room
rooms.description: Designed for couples, solo travelers, or two friends looking for calm and privacy. Natural daylight, clean linen, comfortable bedding, and quiet surroundings make it easy to rest well after a day out in Santiniketan.

rooms.name: The Verandah Twin Room
rooms.description: A bright, welcoming room with easy access to the sit-out area—ideal for reading a book, enjoying morning coffee, or listening to birdsong in the early hours of Bolpur.

rooms.name: The Spacious Family Room
rooms.description: Generous floor space with comfortable sleeping arrangements so parents and children can stay together without feeling crowded. Opens out toward the open courtyard where kids have room to move freely.

rooms.name: The Garden Wing Family Suite
rooms.description: Thoughtfully arranged for families traveling with children or elders who value ground-level ease, quiet nights, and relaxed common spaces for evening conversations. Dressed in handcrafted Santiniketan folk textiles.

reviews.quote: Felt like visiting relatives in Santiniketan, not staying at a commercial property.
reviews.reviewText: We came from Kolkata for a two-day break and loved every bit of our stay at Kunja Homestay. The rooms were spotless, the surroundings were super peaceful, and the morning tea in the open space was the highlight of our trip. Sonajhuri is just a short toto ride away.

reviews.quote: Wonderful for a family trip with elderly parents.
reviews.reviewText: Traveling with senior citizens means you worry about food and comfort, and the hosts took care of everything with so much warmth. Simple, fresh home-cooked Bengali food, clean bathrooms, and zero noise at night. Our parents didn't want to leave!

reviews.quote: Warm hosts, clean rooms, and true Bolpur charm.
reviews.reviewText: If you want to experience the real, quiet side of Shantiniketan away from crowded main-road hotels, this is the place. The hosts helped us arrange a local toto for sightseeing and guided us on the best time to visit Khoai. Looking forward to coming back during Poush Mela.

reviews.quote: Our kids had space to play while we finally got to relax.
reviews.reviewText: We stayed here as a family of four and had such a joyful time. The open surroundings are safe and green, the rooms are airy, and the hospitality is genuinely heartfelt. Having a West Bengal Tourism recognized homestay also gave us complete peace of mind while planning.

mandirFeature.title: Sacred Courtyard Mandir & Heritage Ambiance
mandirFeature.subtitle: A Place of Quiet Devotion & Peaceful Santiniketan Grace
mandirFeature.description: At the heart of Kunja Homestay stands our serene courtyard Mandir, consecrated with daily morning prayers, fresh flowers, and the tranquil chiming of temple bells. Guests are warmly invited to begin their mornings in quiet reflection, soaking in the gentle spiritual energy that makes Kunja feel like a true home in the sacred soil of Bolpur.
